BMW Launches X1 Long Wheelbase Variant in India

BMW has launched the X1 Long Wheelbase (LWB) variant in India. The new model offers increased rear legroom and is positioned to cater to the preferences of the Indian market. This launch signifies BMW's strategy to adapt its global models for specific regional demands, aiming to enhance passenger comfort and appeal.
